name: Brother Neals
summary: At Northshire Abbey, Brother Neals keeps the food and drink stores supplied. He oversees shipments and samples wine from the local vineyard.

sections.title: Keeper of the Cellar
sections.body: From his rooms in the upper belfry, Brother Neals follows grape manifests from the Northshire vineyards. Frequent tastings let him check each vintage. He also tracks deliveries from the valley’s fields, keeping the abbey’s stores supplied.

faq.answer: Brother Neals manages Northshire Abbey’s stores of food, drink, and wine for the clergy and recruits in the valley.

faq.q: Where can Brother Neals be found?
faq.answer: Brother Neals stays in Northshire Abbey’s uppermost room. Climb the stone staircases inside the main hall to reach his quiet chamber near the top of the tower.

faq.q: What is his role regarding the vineyard?
faq.answer: Brother Neals tracks grape harvests and wine shipments from the nearby Northshire Vineyard. He samples the vintage and keeps the ledgers.

angles.text: As someone who manages the monastery’s provisions and spirits, Brother Neals has a role tied to the culinary arts.
